data.text: Customer diligence questions are dragging a bit, so Maple moves from June 23 to July 1, 2026. Please treat July 1 as the current target until a newer decision supersedes it.

prior_context.speaker: sales_rachel_ng
prior_context.text: For Maple, the exact external customer is Granite Mutual, but that mapping stays inside the core room only. Broad updates outside the core room should say 'the insurance pilot' and nothing more specific.

prior_context.speaker: pm_ava_lin
prior_context.text: Recording the current Maple target date as June 23, 2026 while legal redlines and data-masking review continue. Maplemark remains on its own later track and should never be used as a proxy for Maple dates.

prior_context.speaker: manager_alex_romero
prior_context.text: For Maplemark, the customer reference is Greenmark Health. The names Granite and Greenmark are close enough that retrieval and memory need to avoid cross-wiring them.

prior_context.speaker: finance_dana_wu
prior_context.text: Maple's provisional working budget is 262,000 USD before the secret-scanning vendor decision and before travel for the customer readiness workshop. Maplemark has a separate working budget and should never be cited as a shortcut number for Maple.

prior_context.speaker: sales_rachel_ng
prior_context.text: Maple commercial guidance for now: an old exploratory deck mentioned an 11% discount cap, but treat that figure as provisional until finance posts a current approved cap. Do not recirculate the 11% number outside the core team.

prior_context.speaker: legal_sofia_martinez
prior_context.text: The earliest Maple draft still contains auto-renewal language, but I expect that to change after the current customer redline. Please do not quote the stale draft once I post the updated legal position.

prior_context.speaker: security_priya_rao
prior_context.text: Vendor shortlist for Maple secret scanning is CipherTrail versus VaultQuarry. I care more about audit logging, templated-file detection, and deployment friction than about a small price difference.

prior_context.speaker: assistant_erin_blake
prior_context.text: Marco asked me to hold time for a Maple sponsor briefing, but my access remains scheduling-only. I can coordinate calendar blocks and a high-level status line, not the exact customer, detailed budget, discount cap, or incident artifacts.

prior_context.speaker: contractor_leo_park
prior_context.text: Confirming I am attached to Maple only for limited debugging support. Until someone says otherwise, my scope is logs and reproduction notes rather than privileged configuration or customer-facing material.

prior_context.speaker: employee_nina_torres
prior_context.text: Maple/Maplemark background note: workshop logistics, document routing, and review scheduling shifted slightly today without changing any approved commercial, legal, or access-control state.
